findings.explanation: You (the Licensor) must bear all legal and financial liabilities for the content with no monetary cap, which could expose you to unlimited costs.
findings.suggested_change: Licensor shall be responsible for legal liability and royalties arising from the Titles up to an amount not exceeding the total fees payable under this Agreement, and each party shall bear liability for its own breach or negligence.

findings.quoted_text: If, during the Term, Licensor develops or obtains the rights to license any live action or animated feature‑length motion picture (each an "Additional Title"), Licensor shall give Licensee the first right of negotiation for each Additional Title... Licensor will promptly provide written notice to Licensee in which Licensor lists each Additional Title. Should Licensee agree to be the vendor for an Additional Title, Licensor and Licensee will negotiate in good faith to mutually agree upon the pricing and terms for each Additional Title in an amendment to this Agreement.
findings.explanation: You may be required to provide new titles and negotiate pricing for each one without a defined limit or clear change‑order process, which can expand your workload unexpectedly.
findings.suggested_change: Any Additional Title shall be subject to a separate written amendment that specifies the scope, deliverables, pricing, and a mutually agreed change‑order procedure.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body:
Hi,

I’ve reviewed the draft and would like to suggest a small amendment before I sign:

- The relevant clause currently places unlimited liability on the Licensor for all royalties and fees related to the Titles. In plain terms, this means the Licensor could be responsible for costs that far exceed the total fees under the agreement, which may be unreasonable. I propose that the Licensor’s responsibility be limited to an amount not exceeding the total fees payable under the agreement, and that each party bear liability for its own breach or negligence.

Thank you for considering these changes. I look forward to finalizing the agreement.

Best regards
